name: Auto Steam Calculator
author: pponce; calculation and pitcher heuristic inspired by Damian / Damian-AU (DSx2)
description: Estimate steam duration from milk weight using your calibration. Inspired by Damian's DSx2 calculator. This estimates temperature through time; it does not measure milk temperature.

smallPitcherGrams.label: Small empty pitcher (g)
smallPitcherGrams.description: Untared weight of the empty small pitcher. Leave blank or 0 if not configured.

mediumPitcherGrams.label: Medium empty pitcher (g)
mediumPitcherGrams.description: Untared weight of the empty medium pitcher. Leave blank or 0 if not configured.

largePitcherGrams.label: Large empty pitcher (g)
largePitcherGrams.description: Untared weight of the empty large pitcher. Leave blank or 0 if not configured.

singleDrinkGrams.label: Usual milk per drink (g)
singleDrinkGrams.description: Milk only for one drink; used to infer pitcher size in Auto. This can differ from your calibration milk weight.

singleDrinkPitcher.label: Pitcher normally used for one drink
singleDrinkPitcher.description: Select small or medium to choose the pitcher-detection thresholds.

weightMode.label: Scale weight mode
weightMode.description: Gross includes the empty pitcher. Tared is milk only: pitcher size cannot be inferred and no pitcher weight is subtracted.

targetMilkGrams.label: Target milk per reading (g)
targetMilkGrams.description: Milk amount to aim for when preparing each reading. Record the actual measured milk separately; for example, a 160 g target can have a 158 g measurement. Measurements never change this target.

targetTemperatureC.label: Target calibration temperature (°C)
targetTemperatureC.description: Optional milk-temperature note only. It does not control the heater, stop steam or adjust calculated time. Aim for this same temperature for every reading. Update it and repeat the readings if you calibrate at a different temperature.

referenceMilkGrams.label: Calibration milk weight (g)
referenceMilkGrams.description: Milk only, excluding the pitcher, from your measured calibration run.

referenceSeconds.label: Time to your desired milk temperature (s)
referenceSeconds.description: Actual steaming time in the calibration run. Use similar milk, starting temperature and steaming technique for subsequent drinks.

referenceFlow.label: Auto steam flow (ml/s)
referenceFlow.description: Fixed flow for single calibration, or default flow within the multiple-calibration range (0.4–2.5 ml/s).

defaultPitcher.label: Starting pitcher selection
defaultPitcher.description: Small, Medium or Large subtracts that pitcher weight. Auto guesses the pitcher using milk per drink. Streamline remembers subsequent preset selections.

autoDetect.label: Offer Auto pitcher selection
autoDetect.description: Enable automatic detection using Damian’s heuristic. Requires all three pitcher weights, gross scale weight, usual milk per drink and the pitcher normally used for one drink.

calibrationMode.label: Calibration type
calibrationMode.description: Single flow is fixed. Multiple flows interpolate between 2–4 measured calibrations.

flowReadings.label: Measured flow calibrations
flowReadings.description: Managed by the Calibration page. JSON readings with flow, milkGrams and seconds.
